samples.value: Banished to the deepest pits of Hell.
A living nuclear weapon destined to walk the Earth forever. Indestructible. A victim of the modern nuclear age.
Zoom through the sky with a F16C!

Teleport away in a blink of an eye and surprise your opponents with your special ability! All attacks deal 30% less damage while flying. Gigan, a cyborg space kaiju that first appeared in 1972, battling Godzilla. Gigan is a cruel and merciless kaiju, sporting several advanced cybernetic enhancements designed to brutally maim other kaijus and level Earth. Despite all of this, Gigan is actually quite a coward and is derived from a very cute kaiju bird.
A Dying King, Soon to be no more.
